Messages.Author: Ashur
Messages.Body:
What is "a (D) action against you"?

Card text Cesewayo advanced:
"During a (D) action against you, Cesewayo may tap an Aye on him to
untap."

When can Cesewayo untap?

And where in the rulebook is this covered?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Ashur wrote:
> What is "a (D) action against you"?

A directed action that targets you (or something you control).

> Card text Cesewayo advanced:
> "During a (D) action against you, Cesewayo may tap an Aye on him to
> untap."
>
> When can Cesewayo untap?
>
> And where in the rulebook is this covered?
